clean_story: Now I will teach you Ego. Ego is the voice in your head that says "I" and "me." It is the part of you that thinks it is separate from the rest of the tribe, the forest, the sky. It is the feeling that makes you want to be seen as the best hunter, the strongest fighter. It is the thing that makes you proud when you make a good spear, or angry when someone takes your food. It is not your body, not your thoughts, but the one who claims them as its own Ego.
